description: A transparent, evidence-aware roadmap. Delivered means implementation exists, not that every scholarly question is settled. The accuracy audit is an initial, publicly documented editorial screening, not external specialist certification.
currentFocus: Independent specialist review and outstanding bibliography gaps
Scholarly classification of Atlas references with evidence explanations

milestones.title: Bible reading and personal study
milestones.summary: The 66-book navigator, ESV reader, verse search, bookmarks, local notes and reading history form the foundation.
capabilities: All 66 books and chapter navigation
Official Crossway ESV text via server-side API
Bookmarks, private local notes and recent reading
milestones.verification: Available in the live application; text retrieval depends on the Crossway service and applicable licensing.

milestones.title: Ten-hop Connection Atlas
milestones.summary: Explore Scripture connections using curated notes and attributed OpenBible.info cross-references, without treating community vote scores as scholarly confidence.
capabilities: Up to 10 reference hops with bounded rendering
Book / chapter / verse selection and per-verse Atlas actions
603,076 directed reference links imported from 344,753 OpenBible.info source rows
milestones.verification: Dataset importer and CI checks validate reference structure and provenance, not the exegetical validity of each connection. Seven bars are normalised source scores relative to the selected verse, not academic confidence ratings.

milestones.title: Guided study journeys
milestones.summary: Six theme-based entry points and deep links into Scripture.
capabilities: Six curated journeys
Reader links and study notes
milestones.verification: Curated paths are tested for valid Bible references.

milestones.title: Journeys of Jesus
milestones.summary: A self-hosted geographic itinerary following Gospel and Acts passages without drawing invented historical roads.
capabilities: 79 episode entries and 35 places or regions
Interactive pins, repeated visit lists and draggable timeline
Passage links, location confidence and qualified route reconstruction
milestones.verification: Narrative sequence is an editorial harmonisation and not a complete historically dated itinerary.

milestones.title: Place history and archaeology panels
milestones.summary: Historical context for each of the 35 journey markers, while distinguishing scriptural claims from external scholarship.
capabilities: Ancient and modern names and location context
Archaeology summaries with source links where available
Old Testament historical connections and Gospel episode index
milestones.verification: All 35 places have a dossier; depth of independent archaeological references varies by place.

milestones.title: Deployment, provenance and testing
milestones.summary: The site is automatically deployed from a private GitHub repository to Cloudflare Pages.
capabilities: Private GitHub source with production branch builds
Automated Node tests and Pages Functions
ESV API token configured as an encrypted production secret
milestones.verification: Deployment and test results checked; production site remains public despite the private code repository.

milestones.title: Gospel journey audit - initial editorial pass
milestones.summary: All 79 episode entries and 35 place dossiers now have traceable screening states, a publicly visible corrections register, and open historical questions.
capabilities: Passage-reference syntax and Gospel/Acts scope checks
Corrected Capernaum, Jairus lakeshore, Caesarea Philippi district, Bethphage and supper summaries
Published correction history, evidence categories and chronology concerns
Explicitly report unresolved research issues without attached independent secondary-source links
milestones.verification: Initial AI-assisted screening, provenance checks and dated academic bibliography links are documented. Missing secondary citations remain visible. No independent external peer review has occurred.

milestones.title: Five deep historical city studies
milestones.summary: Five browsable studies of Jerusalem, Nazareth, Capernaum, Bethlehem and Jericho, each with source-linked biblical history, chronology and archaeological qualification, plus contested identification comparisons.
capabilities: Five dedicated, independently selectable city pages using one reusable design
40 primary Scripture links, 25 historical period summaries, 20 individually source-qualified findings
Modern site photo licensing and source attribution with illustrative site-orientation maps
Comparative location studies for Cana, Bethsaida and Emmaus
Direct navigation from Journeys of Jesus and to Bible Reader or Connection Atlas
milestones.verification: Implementation, data schema and citations tested. The studies are sourced editorial summaries, not externally peer-reviewed archaeological monographs; coordinate markers are approximations and the photo gallery depicts modern sites.

milestones.title: Gospel chronology comparison
milestones.summary: Compare the order in which the four Gospel texts present the catalogued Jesus-journey episodes, alongside the combined editorial study sequence.
capabilities: Independent Matthew, Mark, Luke and John textual-order selectors based on each account's cited passages
Chronology and possible-parallel notes for disputed Nazareth, temple, Bethany and disciple-call passages
Original Scripture references and linked academic reading, with no invented calendar dates or physical journeys
milestones.verification: Textual sequence follows chapter and verse ordering within each Gospel, not established event dates. Dataset and issue links are validated in automated tests. Full source-critical synoptic comparison and external scholarly review remain outstanding.

milestones.title: Classify references by evidence type
milestones.summary: Distinguish direct quotations, literary echoes, typology, parallels and editorial themes across the complete atlas.
capabilities: Source-verified edge types rather than inferred labels
Reviewer status and confidence/explanation per edge
Browse original context for both ends of each link
milestones.verification: Requires careful human review and should not be auto-labelled from similarity alone.

milestones.title: People, places and events index
milestones.summary: Link biblical persons, locations and key events to the reader, Atlas and journey map.
capabilities: Entity index with alternate names
One-click location and related verses
Person-event-place cross-navigation
milestones.verification: Requires sourced identifiers and name disambiguation.

milestones.title: Switch reader translations
milestones.summary: Read the same verse, range or chapter in ESV, NASB20, NIV (2011) or NKJV without leaving Scripture Trails.
capabilities: Translation selector with saved device preference and shareable edition links
NASB20, NIV and NKJV through a server-side API.Bible integration
Publisher attribution and API.Bible Scripture-view reporting
Translation-neutral Atlas actions retained in every reader edition
milestones.verification: Production verse and full-chapter requests for NASB20, NIV and NKJV verified on 27 October 2026, including returned copyright notices and Scripture-view tokens. ESV retrieval, 56 automated tests, Cloudflare runtime request settings and desktop/mobile browser checks also passed.

milestones.title: Original-language study
milestones.summary: Investigate separately licensed Hebrew and Greek study tools. ESV, NASB20, NIV and NKJV reader switching is implemented separately.
capabilities: Identify licensed Hebrew and Greek lexical datasets
Compare variant renderings only where permissions allow
Carefully sourced original-language study tools
milestones.verification: Do not host additional copyrighted text without an appropriate licence.

milestones.title: Richer notes, exports and reading plans
milestones.summary: Bring linked observations, highlights and optional study plans into one private workspace.
capabilities: Notes linked to multiple verses and places
Export and import personal work with clear privacy notices
Reading goals and optional progress tracking
milestones.verification: Should be accessible, tested and usable without creating an account.

milestones.title: Optional encrypted sync and accounts
milestones.summary: Consider private device sync only after a clear privacy/security design and an actual user need.
capabilities: Opt-in login rather than a sign-up gate
Secure note synchronisation and deletion tools
Privacy policy and encrypted data handling
milestones.verification: Not committed; avoid building accounts before study features are stable.

milestones.title: Wider biblical geography library
milestones.summary: After the Jesus itinerary, consider maps for Paul's journeys, Exodus traditions and Old Testament kings and prophets.
capabilities: Passage-linked maps and dates with explicit ambiguity
Historical geography comparison without invented borders
Accessible visual and list modes
milestones.verification: Require a separate source and chronological audit per map.

milestones.title: Independent historical and textual peer review
milestones.summary: Seek independent scholarly verification of flagged Gospel chronology, textual and archaeological identifications.
capabilities: Review the public audit issue register against primary Scripture
Verify site claims with excavation publications and mapped historical data
Document human specialist reviewer and method only when such reviews occur
milestones.verification: Not completed: initial AI-assisted editorial screening must not be represented as external independent review.

milestones.title: Locally stored reference data and supporting assets
milestones.summary: The original OpenBible.info archive and all 66 generated Atlas files are stored with the project. Five credited city photographs are also served locally.
capabilities: 344799 source reference rows, with 344753 valid non-self rows imported
603076 directed navigation links across 66 book files
Source and generated-file checksums, provenance and attribution
Offline dataset regeneration with no reference download during builds
Local history, geography, verse metadata and city photographs
milestones.verification: All source reference pairs match an official OpenBible download. Vote counts differ by snapshot date. The original archive is retained unchanged, generated-file checksums are validated during builds, and publisher Bible APIs remain separate.
